text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning to enable per-tenant batching for EU tomorrow 2026-03-18 09:00 UTC. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m bake between steps. Need: flag pusher, smoke watcher, rollback ready. ETA ~40m. Who can own?

jake: I can push the flag and watch first 15m. I'll be near laptop. :thumbsup:

anika: I'll run the smoke script and monitor p95/p99 latency + error rate. Post any anomalies to #eng-sre. Which flag/key?

maria: flag key: features.per_tenant_batching.eu
Safe default: false (no batching). Operator toggle endpoint:
```
POST https://internal-admin.redwood/v1/flags
{
  "key": "features.per_tenant_batching.eu",
  "value": true,
  "target_percent": 5
}
```
Rollback command:
```
POST https://internal-admin.redwood/v1/flags
{
  "key": "features.per_tenant_batching.eu",
  "value": false
}
```
Smoke checklist:
- run `scripts/smoke/eu_batch_smoke.sh 50` (will generate 50 requests across 10 tenants)
- check Console -> Models -> EU -> p50/p95 token latency and throughput
- verify error rate <0.5% and no 4xx spikes
- confirm no KV cache OOMs or GPU mem errors in logs
If any fail, trigger rollback and ping @maria @jake @anika.

sam: noted. I can standby to cut the rollback if needed.

deploy-bot: Scheduled flag change created by jake for 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z. ID: fb-98765 :robot_face:

jake: I'll start at 08:55 UTC, push 5% then wait 15m. If green, increment to 25% and watch next 15m. Final to 100% at ~09:30. Will paste commands here live.

anika: I'll post a short runbook snippet to #eng-platform-runbooks after we finish.

maria: Thanks — ownership: jake (flag push), anika (smoke), sam (rollback), maria (coord). Please ack.

jake: ack

anika: ack

sam: ack :white_check_mark:
